English: An emm-cluster based system was proposed as a standard typing scheme to facilitate and enhance future studies of Group A Streptococcus (Strep A) epidemiological surveillance, M protein function and vaccine development strategies.
Luganda: Omuyungiro gw’ebibinja bya emm gwateesebwa ng'enseetuka ey'olugerero esobozesa n’okuyamba mu kunoonyereza okw’omu maaso okw’ekibinja A Situleputokookasi (Strep A), obulondondoozi bw’endwadde, omugaso gwa puloteyini ekika kya M n’obukodyo bw’okukulaakulanya eddagala erigema.
Yoruba: Ìmọ̀ràn ètò yìí tí ó dá lórí àṣùpọ̀-emm, ni iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí mú wá gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀pagun ìlànà láti mú ìrọ̀rùn bá iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ní ọjọ́ iwájú àti ìlànà sọ̀féè àjàkálẹ̀-àrùn fún Ìpín A kòkòrò ààrun sitirẹtokókọ́ọ̀sì(Strep A), purotéènì M àti ìlànà ìmúgbèrú abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára.
Zulu: Uhlelo lokwenza oluphakanyiswe njengokuyilo olumelwe ukusetshenziswa uma ngabe sekwenziwa ucwaningo esikhatbhini esizayo, lubheka i-Streptococus kanye nokugadwa kokusebenza kwe M protein.
Hausa: An gabatar da tsarin tushen gungun emm a matsayin madaidaicin tsarin nau’in don sauƙaƙe da haɓaka nazarin nan gaba na sa-ido a kan yaɗuwar Rukunin A na ƙwayoyin cutar Streptococcus (Strep A), aikin M protein da dabarun haɓaka maganin.
Northern Sotho: Lenaneo leo le theilwego go sehlophana sa emm le šišintšwe bjalo ka setlamo sa tlwaleo sa go dira mehuta go nolofatša le go maatlafatša dinyakišišo ka ga nyakišišo ka ga malwetši mabapi le Streptococcus ya Sehlopha sa A (Strep A), go šoma ga M protein le mekgwa ya tšweletšo ya moento.
Amharic: የቡድን ኤ ስትሬፕቶኮከስ (ስትሬፕ ኤ) ስነ-ወረርሺኛዊ ክትትል፣ የኤም ፕሮቲን ተግባር እና የክትባት ዝግጅት ስትራቴጂዎች የወደፊት ጥናቶችን ለማመቻቸት እና ለማሻሻል ኤም ስብስብን መሰረት ያደረገ ስርዓት እንደ መደበኛ የመተየብ ዕቅድ ቀርቧል።

English: We provide an evidence-based distribution of Strep A emm clusters in Africa and assess the potential coverage of the new 30-valent vaccine in terms of an emm cluster-based approach.
Luganda: Tulaga ensaasaana y’ebibinja bya Strep A emm eyeesigamiziddwa ku kunoonyereza mu Afirika era ne twekenneenya obusobosi bw’obusaasaane bw’eddagala erigema erya 30-valent nga tusinziira ku njolekera y’ebibinja bya emm.
Yoruba: A ṣe àgbékalẹ̀-aláfihan lórí àṣùpọ̀ Strep A emm ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà tí a sì tún ṣe àyẹ̀wò abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára oní falẹ́ńtì-30 ní ìlànà ajẹmọ-àṣùpọ̀.
Zulu: Siveza izinhlobo ze-amm e-Afrika, sihlaziye ukuthi ngabe umgomo ungakwazi ukuba nomthelela kwezingaki.
Hausa: Muna ba shaidar rarrabuwar tushen gungun emm Strep A a Afirka kuma muna tantance yiwuwar ɗaukar sabon maganin 30-valent dangane da tsarin tushen gungu emm.
Northern Sotho: Re fana ka phatlalatšo ye e theilwego go dihlophana tša Strep A emm ka Afrika le go sekaseka kakaretšo ye e kgonagalago ya moento wa dibalente tše 30 go ya ka mokgwa wa dihlophana tša emm.

English: Eight studies (n=1,595 isolates) revealed the predominant emm clusters as E6 (18%, 95% confidence interval (CI), 12.6; 24.0%), followed by E3 (14%, 95%CI, 11.2; 17.4%) and E4 (13%, 95%CI, 9.5; 16.0%).
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwa mirundi munaana (ebyawule n=1,595) kwalaga ebibinja bya emma ebisinga okulabika nga biri E6 (18%, 95% confidence interval (CI), 12.6; 24.0%), nga biddirirwa E3 (14%, 95%CI, 11.2; 17.4%) %) ne E4 (13%, 95%CI, 9.5; 16.0%).
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí mẹjọ (n=1,595 adádúró) ṣe àfihàn àṣùpọ̀ emm èyí tó ṣe pàtàkì jùlọ bíi E6 (18%, 95% èyí tí kò jìnnà sí (CI), 12.6; 24.0%), E3 (14%, 95% CI, 11.2; 17.4%) àti E4 sì tẹ̀lé e (13%, 95%CI, 9.5; 16.0%).
Zulu: Ucwaningo uluyisishiyagalombili (n=1,595 wokuhlukana) luveze ukuthi izinhlobo zegciwane eziseqoqweni le emm ingama-E6 (18%, 95% ku-confidence interval(CI) 12.6; 24.0%), ebese ilandelwa ngamaE3 (14%, 95%CI, 11.2;17.4%) ku E4 (13%, 95%CI, 9.5; 16.0%).
Hausa: Nazari guda takwas (n=1,595 na keɓe) ya bayyana manyan gungun emm kamar E6 (18%, 95% tazarar amincewa (CI), 12.6; 24.0%), sannan biye da E3 (14%, 95% CI, 11.2; 17.4%) da kuma E4  (13%, 95%CI, 9.5; 16.0%).
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše seswai (n=1,595 isolates) di utollotše dihlopha tše ntši tša emm bjalo ka E6 (18%, 95% confidence interval (CI), 12.6; 24.0%), gwa latela ke E3 (14%, 95%CI, 11.2; 17.4%) le E4 (13%, 95%CI, 9.5; 16.0%).
Amharic: ስምንት ጥናቶች (ቁ=1,595 ገለልተኞች) እንዳሳዩት ዋናዎቹ የኤም ስብስቦች ፡ E6 (18%፣ 95% የመተማመን ክፍተት (መ.ክ)፣ 12.6፤ 24.0%)፣ በማስከተል E3 (14%፣ 95%መ.ክ፣ 11.2፤ 17.4%) እና E4 (13%, 95%CI, 9.5; 16.0%).

English: There is negligible variation in emm clusters as regards regions, age and socio-economic status across the continent.
Luganda: Waliwo enjawulo ntono nnyo ddala wakati w’ebibinja bya emm bw’oba ng’otunuulidde ebitunndu, emyaka, Embeera y’ebyenfuna mu ssemazinga ez’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àlàfó tí kò pọ̀ wà nínú àṣùpọ̀ emm, èyí tí ó ní ṣe, pẹ̀lú agbègbè, ọjọ́ orí àti ipò ọrọ̀ ajé káàkiri àgbáyé.
Zulu: Kunokushintshashintsha okungnakekile kwiqoqo le-emm kokumayelana nezifunda, iminyaka kanye sesimosenhlalo kwi-Afrika yonkana.
Hausa: Akwai bambance-bambancen ‘yan kaɗan a cikin gungun emm dangane da yankuna da shekaru da matsayin zamantakewa da tattalin arziki a duk faɗin nahiyar.
Northern Sotho: Go na le phapano ye e sa hlokomelwego ka go dihlophana tša emm mabapi le dilete, mengwaga le maemo a ekonomi ya setšhaba go lalal le khonthinente.

English: Considering an emm cluster-based vaccine strategy, which assumes cross-protection within clusters, the 30-valent vaccine currently in clinical development, would provide hypothetical coverage to 80.3% of isolates in Africa.
Luganda: Okutunuulira akakodyo k’eddagala erigema akeesigamiziddwa ku bibinja bya emm akafaayo ku kukuuma ebibinja byonna, eddagala lya 30-valent erigema erikulaakulanyizibwa mu kiseera kino lisobola okuteeberezebwa okukola ku byawule (isolates) 80.3% mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Tí a bá wo ìlànà abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára tí ó ní ṣe pẹ̀lú àṣùpọ̀ emm, èyí tí ó máa ń dáàbò bo àwọn àṣùpọ̀ tí ó wà ní gbèdéke kan náà papọ̀, abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára oní falẹ́ńtì-30 èyi tí ó wà ní ipò ìmúgbèrú ninú ìṣèwòsàn lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, yíò pèsè ìgbéléwọ̀n tí ó le kó ìdá 80.3 ní ti ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Uma kubhekwa umgomo omayelana ne-emm nokuwumgomo oveza ukuvikela kwizinhlobo eziwu-30 ezehlukene zegciwane, kuvela ukuthi angama-80.3% wamaphesenti engavikela ngawo e-Afrika
Hausa: Ta yin la’akari da dabarun maganin ƙwayar gungun emm, wanda yake ɗaukar matakan kariya a cikin gungu, a halin yanzu ana ƙoƙarin samar da maganin 30-valent, wanda hasashe zai warkar da kashi 80.3% a keɓe a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Ge go lebeletšwe leano la meento leo le theilwego go dihlophana tša emm, leo le tšeago diphrotheine ka kakaretšo ka gare ga dihlophana, moento wa dibalente tše 30 wo mo lebakeng le o sa tšweletšwago go tša kalafo, o tla fana ka kakaretšo ya ka kgopolong go 80.3% ya bao ba kgethilwego ka Afrika.
Amharic: የኤም ስብስብ- ተኮር የክትባት ስልትን በተመለከተ በስብስቦች ውስጥ ተሻጋሪ-ጥበቃ እንዳለ ይገመታል፡፡ በአሁኑ ጊዜ በክሊኒክ በመሰራት ላይ ያለው የ 30-ቫለንት ክትባት በአፍሪካ 80.3% ለሚሆኑት ገለልተኞች መላምታዊ ሽፋን ይሰጣል ተብሎ ይታሰባል፡፡

English: This systematic review indicates the most predominant Strep A emm cluster in Africa is E6 followed by E3, E4 and D4.

Zulu: Lesi sibuyekezo siveza ukuthi uhlobo lwegciwane olwande kakhulu kunazo zonke e-Afrika yi-E6 ilandelwa yi-E3, E4 kanye ne-D4.
Hausa: Wannan tsararriyar bita tana nuna babban gungu emm na Strep A a Afirka shi ne E6 wanda E3, E4 da kuma D4 suka biyo baya.
Northern Sotho: Tekodišišo ye e laetša sehlophana se sentši kudu sa Strep A emm ka Afrika ke E6 gwa latela ke E3, E4 le D4.

English: The current 30-valent vaccine would provide considerable coverage across the diversity of emm cluster types in Africa.

Yoruba: Abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára oní falẹ́ńtì-30 tí ó ń lọ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ máa kó onírúurú ọ̀wọ́ àṣùpọ̀ emm papọ̀ káàkiri ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.

English: To inform vaccine development for group A streptococcus (Strep A), we report on the epidemiology of the M Protein emm clusters from Strep A infections in Africa, where Strep A-related illnesses and their sequalae including rheumatic fever and rheumatic heart disease, are of a high burden.

Hausa: An gano sama da ‘nau’o’i’ 200 na GAS, don haka masana kimiyya sun samar da tsarin haɗa nau’o’in, bisa bambance-bambance a cikin furoti na musamman da ake kira M protein.
Northern Sotho: Mehutahuta goba ‘mehutta’ ye e fetago ye 200 ya GAS e utollotšwe, ka fao bašomi ba tša mahlale ba hlamile lenaneo la go hlopha mehuta ye, go lebeletšwe diphapano ka go phrotheine ye itšego ye e bitšwago M protein.
Amharic: ከ200 በላይ የGAS ዝርያዎች ወይም “ዓይነቶች” ተለይተዋል፤ ስለዚህ ሳይንቲስቶች ኤም ፕሮቲን በተባለው ልዩ ፕሮቲን አማካኝነት በሚመጡ ልዩነቶች ላይ ተመርኩዘው በቡደን የማስቀመጥ ስርዓትን ፈጥረዋል።

English: Using this approach, they developed a vaccine targeting groups of similar types, called emm clusters.
Luganda: Mu kukozesa enkola eno, baakola eddagala erigema nga baluubirira ebika eby’engeri emu ebiyitibwa ebibinja emm.
Yoruba: Làtàrí ìlò ọ̀nà yìí, wọ́n ṣe àwárí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára tí yóò ṣiṣẹ́ fún àwọn ààrùn tí ó tún fi ara pẹ́ ẹ, èyí tí a mọ̀ sí àṣùjọ emm.
Zulu: Ngokusebenzisa le ndlela babe sebesungula umgomo obhekene ngqo namaqoqo anezinhlobo ezifanayo zegciwane nokuyiqoqo elaziwa nge-emm.
Hausa: Ta yin amfani da wannan hanyar, sun samar da wani maganin don rukunoni iri ɗaya, wanda ake kira gungun emm.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša mokgwa wo, ba hlamile moento wo o lebišitšwego go dihlopha tša mohuta wa go swana, tšeo di bitšwago dihlophana tša emm.
Amharic: ይህን አካሄድ በመጠቀም ኤም ስብስቦች የተባሉትን ተመሳሳይ ዓይነት ቡድኖችን ዒላማ ያደረገ ክትባት ፈጥረዋል።

English: The vaccine is based on data from studies in developed countries, but little information is available on how useful it would be in Africa.
Luganda: Eddagala erigema lyesigamiziddwa ku byakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu kunoonyereza mu mawanga agaakula edda, naye nga waliwo obubaka butono ddala ku ngeri gye liyinza okugasaamu mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára yìí ni wọn gbé lórí àwọn dátà ìwádìí tí wọ́n ṣe tí àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí wọn ti gbèrú, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn àlàyé díẹ̀ wà lórí bí ó ṣe máa wúlò sí ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Umngomo lo usungulwe kusetshenziswa ulwazi olutholakele ocwaningweni olwenziwe emazweni asethuthukile, kepha luncane kakhulu ulwazi olukhona olumayelana nokuthi ngabe lo mgomo uzosebenza yini e-Afrika.
Hausa: An samo maganin ne bisa bayanai daga binciken da aka yi a ƙasashen da suka ci gaba, amma bayanai kadan aka sanu a kan yadda za a yi amfani da shi a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Moento wo o theilwe go tshedimošo ye e tšwago ka dinyakišišong ka dinageng tšeo di hlabologilego, eupša tshedimošo ye nnyane e a hwetšagala mabapi le ka fao e ka bago mohola ka Afrika.
Amharic: ክትባቱ ባደጉት ሃገራት ከተደረጉት ጥናቶች በተገኙ መረጃዎች ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው፤ ነገር ግን በአፍሪካ ምን ያህል ጠቃሚ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ብዙ መረጃ የለም።

English: In this study, researchers compared data from other GAS studies in African countries to determine which emm clusters are the most common across the continent.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baageraageranya ebyakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu kunoonyereza okulala okwa GAS mu mawanga ga Afirika okulaba ebibinja bya emm ebisinga okulabika ku ssemazinga ono.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùwádìí sí àfiwé àwọn dátà tí ó wà nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí GAS yóò ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà láti lè rí àrídájú irúfẹ́ àṣùjọ emm tí ó wọ̀pọ̀ jùlọ ní gbogbo àgbáyé.
Zulu: Kulolucwaningo abacwaningi baqhathanise ulwazi oluvela ocwaningweni olunye oselwenziwe olumayelana naleli gciwane emazweni ase-Afrika ukuze bakwazi ukuthola ukuthi kulezi zinhlobo ezehlukaniswe ngamaqoqo ngabe Ilona luphi uhlobo oluvamile ezwenikazi i-Afrika.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu bincike sun kwatanta bayanai daga sauran nazari a kan GAS a cikin ƙasashen Afirka don tantance ko wane nau’i na gungun emm ne ya fi zama ruwan-dare a faɗin nahiyar.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba bapeditše tshedimošo go tšwa go dinyakišišo tše dingwe tša GAS ka dinageng tša Afrika go tseba gore ke dihlophana dife tša emm tšeo di tlwaelegilego kudu go ralala le khonthinente.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ ተመራማሪዎች በአህጉሪቱ ውስጥ የትኞቹ የኤም ስብስቦች በጣም የተለመዱ እንደሆኑ ለማወቅ ከሌሎች የአፍሪካ ሃገራት GAS ጥናቶች የተገኘውን መረጃ አወዳድረዋል።

English: In particular, they wanted to understand how effective the current vaccine is likely to be in the region.
Luganda: Okusinga ennyo, baayagala okutegeera engeri eddagala erigema gye liyinza okukolamu mu kitundu ky’ensi kino.
Yoruba: Ní pàtó, wọ́n fẹ́ ní òye tí ó dunjú lórí bí ó tí ṣeéṣe kí abẹ́rẹ àjẹsára náà ṣiṣẹ́ ní agbègbè náà.
Zulu: Kahle kahle bebefuna ukuthola ukthi ngabe lo mgomo okhona njengamanje uzoba nomthelela omungakanani kwisifunda sase-Afrika.
Hausa: Musamman ma, suna son fahimtar yadda tasirin maganin na yanzu zai iya kasancewa a yankin.
Northern Sotho: Gabotse, ba be ba nyaka go kwešiša ka fao moento wa bjale o ka kgonago go šoma gabotse ka gona ka mo seleteng.
Amharic: በተለይም አሁን ያለው ክትባት በክልሉ ውስጥ ምን ያህል ውጤታማ  ሊሆን እንደሚችል ለመረዳት ፈልገዋል።

English: The researchers started with a broad search of scientific articles about GAS in Africa, and then narrowed their findings down to the ones that specifically dealt with emm clusters.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baatandikira ku kuwenja biwandiiko bya kunoonyereza ebikwata ku GAS mu Afirika, ate oluvannyuma ne baddira bye baazuula ne babisonza ku ebyo ebitunuulirira ddala ebibinja bya emm.
Yoruba: Olùwádìí náà bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú wíwá àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwadìí sáyẹ́ńsì tí ó wà ní àkọsílẹ̀ nípà Áfíríkà ní gbòòrò, kí wọ́n tó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ wá gbájúmọ mọ́ àwọn tí wọ́n níí ṣe pẹ̀lú àṣùjọ emm ní pàtó.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqale ngokubheka kabanzi imibhalo yesayensi ekhuluma ngalo leli gciwane e-Afrika, babe sebenciphisa abakutholile kuze kufike kulokho okubhekana ngqo nezinhlobo zegciwane ezikwiqoqo le-emm.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun fara ne da wani faffaɗan bincike na ƙasidun kimiyya game da GAS a Afirka, sannan suka taƙaita nazarinsu zuwa na musamman da suka yi magana game da gungun emm.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba thomile ka go nyaka ka kakaretšo diathekele tša mahlale ka ga GAS ka Afrika, gomme ba fokotša dikutollo tša bona gwa šala tšeo di bego di šoma kudu ka dihlophana tša emm.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአፍሪካ ሰፋ ያሉ ሳይንሳዊ መጣጥፎችን ስለ GAS በመፈለግ የጀመሩ ሲሆን ግኝቶቻቸውን በተለይ ኤም ስብስቦች ላይ ወደሚያተኩሩት ጠበብ አድርገው ነበር።

English: This left them with a total of eight studies, spread across five countries: South Africa, Mali, Kenya, Tanzania, and Tunisia.
Luganda: Kye baakola kyabaleetera okusigaza okunoonyereza kwa mirundi munaana nga kuli mu mawanga ataanu: South Afirika, Mali, Kenya, Tanzania, ne Tunisia.
Yoruba: Èyí ni ó fún wọn ní iṣẹ́ ìwadìí mẹ́jọ, ní èyí tí ó wà káàkiri orílẹ̀ èdè Márùn ún: South Africa, Mali, Kenya, Tanzania, àti Tunisia.
Zulu: Inani locwaningo abalwenzile selilonke liba yisishiyagalombili nolwenziwe emazweni amahlanu. La mazwe kubalwa kuwo iNingizimu Afrika, iMali, iTanzania kanye nezwe laseTunisia.
Hausa: Wannan ya bar su da jimillar nazarce-nazarce guda takwas, waɗanda aka suka bazu a ƙasashe guda biyar: Afirka ta Kudu da Mali da Kenya, Tanzaniya da kumaTunisiya.
Northern Sotho: Se se dirile gore ba šale ka palomoka ya dinyakišišo tše seswai, tšeo di phatlaladitšwego le dinaga tše hlano e lego: Afrika Borwa, Mali, Kenya, Tanzania, le Tunisia.
Amharic: ይህም በአጠቃላይ ከአምስት ሃገሮች ከተገኙ ስምንት ጥናቶች ጋር አስቀርቷቸዋል: ደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ ማሊ፣ ኬንያ፣ ታንዛኒያ እና ቱኒዚያ።

English: By analysing those studies in more detail, the researchers were able to pin-point which emm clusters were most common, and how many individual types of GAS had been found.
Luganda: Bwe beekaliriza okunoonyereza okwo mu bwesovvu obusingako, abanoonyereza baasobola okusonga ku bibinja bya emm ebisinga okulabika, n’ebika bya GAS kinnakimu ebyali bizuuliddwa.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yin òríkíniwín ìtúpalẹ̀ àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwadìí wọ̀nyí, àwọn olùwádìí rí àrídájú àwọn agbègbè tí àṣùjọ emm yìí wọ́pọ̀ sí jùlọ, àti iye irúfẹ́ GAS tí wọ́n ti rí.
Zulu: Ngokuhlaziyisisisa ucwaningo olwenziwe kulamazwe, abacwaningi bakwazile ukukhomba ukuthi imaphi amaqoqo egciwane avamile nanokuthi zingaki izinhlobo ezehluke ngazodwana ezitholakele.
Hausa: Ta hanyar nazarin waɗannan binciken daki-daki, masu binciken sun sami damar tantance gungun emm waɗanda suka fi zama ruwan-dare, da kuma ɗaiɗaikun nau’o’in GAS aka samu.
Northern Sotho: Ka go sekaseka dinyakišišo tšeo ka botlalo, banyakišiši ba kgonne go hlatha gore ke dihlophana dife tša emm tšeo di bego di tlwaelegile kudu, le gore ke mehuta efe ya GAS yeo e hweditšwego.
Amharic: እነዚያን ጥናቶች በበለጠ ዝርዝር በመተንተን ተመራማሪዎቹ የትኞቹ የኤም ስብስቦች በጣም የተለመዱ እንደሆኑ እና ምን ያህል ነጠላ የGAS ዓይነቶች እንደተገኙ ማወቅ ችለዋል።

English: They then compared that information to the specific types of GAS targeted by the newly developed vaccine.
Luganda: Olwo ate ne bageraageranya obubaka obwo ku bika bya GAS ebimu ebiruubirira eddagala erigema eppya eryakakolebwa.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn èyí ni wọ́n wá ṣe àfiwéra àwọn ohun tí wọ́n ti ri kójọ pẹ̀lú irúfẹ́ GAS tí wọ́n fẹ́ fi orí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsárà náà sọ ní pàtọ́.
Zulu: Babe sebeqhathanisa ulwazi abalutholile nezinhlobo ezithize zegciwane eziqondwezibhekene ngqo nohlobo lomgomo omusha owenziwe.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka kwatanta wannan bayanin da nau’o’in musamman na GAS da sabon maganin aka yi niyya.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba bapetša tshedimošo yeo le mehuta ye itšego ya GAS yeo e bego e nepišitšwe ke moento wo o sa tšwago go tšweletšwa.
Amharic: ከዚያም ያንን መረጃ አዲስ የተዘጋጀው ክትባት ዒላማ ካደረጋቸው ልዩ የGAS ዓይነቶች ጋር አነጻጽረውታል።

English: They found four common clusters that appeared across the continent, but they didn’t see much variation in the age or socioeconomic status of people affected by them.
Luganda: Baazuula ebibinja ebisinga okulabika ku ssemazinga bina naye tebaalabawo nnyo njawulo mu myaka oba mu byenfuna y’abantu abaali bakosebwa.
Yoruba: Oríṣìí àṣùjọ mẹ́rin pàtó ni wọ́n rí tí ó wà káàkiri gbogbo àgbáyé, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò rí ìyàtọ̀ tí ó pọ̀ nínú ọjọ́ orí tàbí ipò ọ̀rọ̀-ajé-awùjọ àwọn ènìỳn tí wọ́n ní àrùn yìí.
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi izinhlobo ezine ezivele kumazwe ase-Afrika ehlukene kepha zange babone umehluko omngako eminyakeni kanye nakwisimo senhlalo sabantu abahlaselwa yizo lezi zinhlobo zegciwane.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun sami gungu huɗu na gama-gari waɗanda suka bayyana a duk faɗin nahiyar, amma ba su ga bambanci da yawa a cikin shekaru ko matsayin tattalin arziƙin mutanen da abin ya shafa ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše dihlopha tše nne tšeo di tlwaelegilego tšeo di tšweletšego go ralala le khonthinente, eupša ga se ba bona phapano ka go mengwaga goba ka go maemo a ekonomi ya setšhaba ka ga batho bao ba angwago ka tšona.
Amharic: በአህጉሪቱ ውስጥ የሚታዩ አራት የተለመዱ ስብስቦችን አግኝተዋል ነገር ግን በእነሱ የተጠቁ ሰዎች ዕድሜ ወይም ማህበራዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ሁኔታ ላይ ብዙ ልዩነት አላዩም።

English: When they compared the types of GAS that occurred in Africa to types the vaccine protects against, they found that the vaccine was likely to be effective for around 60% of types.
Luganda: Bwe baageraageranya ebika bya GAS ebiri mu Afirika n’ebyo ebigemebwa n’eddagala ly’okugema, baakizuula nti eddagala erigema lyalabika okubeera nga likola ku bika nga ebitundu 60%.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí wọn ṣe àfiwẹ́ra irúfẹ́ GAS tí ó wà ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà dórí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsárà tí wọ́n ń lò fún ààbò rẹ̀, wọn ríi dájú pé ó ṣe é ṣe kí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsárà náà ṣiṣẹ dunra fún bí ìdá 60 onírúurú àwọn ààrùn náà.
Zulu: Uma beqhathanisa izinhlobo zegciwane ezitholakala e-Afrika kanye nomngomo wokuvikela lezi zinhlobo, bathola ukuthi lo mgomo ungakwazi ukuvikela ngamaphasenti angama-60%
Hausa: A yayin da suka kwatanta nau’o’in GAS da ke aukuwa a Afirka da nau’in maganin da ke kare su, sun gano cewa maganin na iya yin tasiri ga kusan kashi 60% na nau’o’in.
Northern Sotho: Ge ba bapetša mehuta ya GAS yeo e tšweletšego ka Afrika le mehuta yeo e šireletšwago ke moento, ba utollotše gore moento go na le kgonagalo wa gore o ka šoma gabotse go tekano ya 60%.
Amharic: በአፍሪካ ውስጥ የተከሰቱትን የGAS ዓይነቶች ክትባቱ ከሚከላከለው አይነት ጋር ሲያወዳድሩ ክትባቱ ወደ 60% ለሚሆኑት ዓይነቶች ውጤታማ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተገንዝበዋል።

English: The researchers point out, however, that the vaccine might provide better protection against types that are part of the same emm clusters.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baategeeza nti, wadde nga kiri kityo, eddagala erigema liyinza okutaasa omuntu mu ngeri esingako eri ebibinja bya emm ebifaanagana.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí fàá yọ pé, ó ṣe é ṣe kí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsárà náà ṣiṣẹ́ fún ààbò fùn irúfẹ́ àwọn àṣùjọ emm kan náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bayakuveza nokho ukuthi lo mgomo kungenzeka uvikele kangcono kulezi zinhlobo zegciwane eziseqoqweni elilodwa le-emm.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun nuna, duk da haka, cewa maganin na iya samar da ingantacciyar kariya daga nau’o’in da suke cikin gungu na emm iri ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di bolela gore, le ge go le bjale, moento o ka fana ka tšhireletšo ye kaone kgahlanong le mehuta yeo e lego karolo ya dihlophana tše di swanago tša emm.
Amharic: ነገር ግን  ተመራማሪዎቹ ክትባቱ ከተመሳሳይ የኤም ስብስቦች አካል ከሆኑ ዓይነቶች የተሻለ ሊከላከል እንደሚችል ጠቁመዋል።

English: In practice, that could mean the vaccine would protect people against 80% of GAS types found in Africa.
Luganda: Mu bikolebwa byennyini, kino kitegeza nti eddagala erigema lisobola okutaasa abantu ebika bya GAS ebitundu 80% ebisangibwa mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Ní ṣíṣe, èyí lè túnmọ̀ sí pé abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsárà máa dáàbò bo àwọn èèyàn ní kíkó ìdá 80 ààrùn irúfẹ́ GAS tí wọ́n ṣàwárí ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Uma sekujovwa abantu, lokhu kusho ukuthi lo mgomo ungavikela abantu ezinhlotsheni zegciwane ezingam,aphesenti angama-80% kuzona zonke izinhlobo zaleli gciwane ezitholaka e-Afrika.
Hausa: Ke nan a aikace, wannan na iya nufin maganin zai kare mutane daga kashi 80% na nau’o’in GAS da ake samu a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Gabotse, seo se ka ra gore moento o ka šireletša batho kgahlanong le 80% ya mehuta ya GAS yeo e hwetšwago ka Afrika.
Amharic: ይህ ማለት በተግባር ክትባቱ ሰዎችን በአፍሪካ ውስጥ ከሚገኙ 80% የGAS ዓይነቶች ይከላከላል ማለት ነው።

English: The findings show that the new GAS vaccine is likely to be effective in Africa, but the researchers do note that the common African emm clusters are not the same as those seen in many other parts of the world.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa biraga nti eddagala erigema GAS eppya lyandiba nga likola bulungi mu Afirika naye abanoonyereza bakirengera nti ebibinja bya emma ebisinga okulabika mu Afirika si bye bimu n’ebyo ebirabika mu bitundu by’ensi ebirala.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí fi hàn pé ó ṣe é ṣe kí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsárà GAS tuntun ṣiṣẹ́ dáàdáà ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn olùwádìí pé àkíyèsí sí pé àṣùpọ emm ti ó wọ́pọ̀ ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà kìí ṣe nǹkan kan náà pẹ̀lú irúfẹ́ àwọn tí wọ́n rí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ibi yòókù ní àgbàyé.
Zulu: Izphumo zocwaningo ziyaveza ukuthi umngomo waleli gciwane ungasebenza ukuvikela e-Afrika, kepha abacwaningi bayakuveza futhi ukuthi izinhlobo zegciwane ezingaphansi kweqoqo le-emm kazifani nalezo ezitholakala kwamanye amazwe omhlaba.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa sabon maganin na GAS na iya yin tasiri a nahiyar Afirka, amma masu binciken sun lura da cewa gungun emm na Afirka na yau da kullum ba kamar yadda ake gani a sauran sassan duniya ba ne.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo di laetša gore moento o moswa wa GAS go na le kgonagalo ya gore o ka šoma gabotse ka Afrika, eupša banyakišiši ba lemoga gore dihlophana tša emm ga di swane le tše dingwe tša ka dikarolong tše dingwe tše ntši tša lefaseng.
Amharic: ግኝቶቹ እንደሚያሳዩት አዲሱ የGAS ክትባት በአፍሪካ ውጤታማ ሊሆን ይችላል ነገር ግን ተመራማሪዎቹ የተለመደው የአፍሪካ ኤም ስብስብ በሌሎች በርካታ የዓለም ክፍሎች ከሚታየው ጋር ተመሳሳይ እንዳልሆነ ይጠቁማሉ።

English: In the future, including under-represented types when developing vaccines could make it more effective in an African context.
Luganda: Mu biseera eby’omu maaso, okufaayo ku ebika ebitakiikiriddwa bulungi mu kukola eddagala erigema kiyinza okuleetera eddagala okukola obulungi mu bitundu by’omu Afirika.
Yoruba: Ní ọjọ́ iwájú, tí wọn bá ṣe àfikùn àwọn èyí ti kò hàn nínú iṣẹ́ ìwadìí ní ìgbà tí wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ lórí àwọn abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsárà yìí, yóò mú kí ó túbọ̀ ṣiṣẹ́ síi ní ti Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Esikhathini esizayo, ukuvela kancane kwezinye izinhlobo zegciwane kungenza ukuthi uma ngabe kwenziwa umgomo, ube nomthelela omkhulu usebenze e-Afrika ukulwisana negciwane.
Hausa: A nan gaba, ciki har da nau’o’in da ba su da wakilci yayin haɓaka maganin na iya yin tasiri sosai a cikin yanayin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Ka moso, go akaretšwa mehuta ye e sego ya emelwa kudu ge go tšweletšwa meento go ka dira gore e šome kudu ka seemong sa Afrika.
Amharic: ለወደፊቱ ክትባቶች በሚመረቱበት ጊዜ በበቂ ሁኔታ ያልተወከሉ ዓይነቶችን መጨመር በአፍሪካ አውድ የበለጠ ውጤታማ ያደርጋቸዋል።

English: The researchers mentioned that there is also a lack of information about GAS in many low- and middle-income African countries.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakyogerako nti waliwo ebbula ly’obubaka obukwata ku GAS mu mawanga ag’enfuna entono n’ago agali yaddeyaddeko mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí fi ẹnu bà pé, ìmọ̀ kò pọ̀ tó nípa GAS ní àwọn orílẹ èdè tí ọrọ̀-ajé wọn kò dára tó.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakubalulile nokuthi luyashoda ulwazi ngaleli gciwane emazweni amaningi ase-Afrika asatotoba ngakwezomnotho.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayyana cewa akwai kuma ƙarancin bayanai game da GAS a mafi yawancin ƙasashen Afirka masu ƙaramin ƙarfi da matsakaita.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore gape go na le tlhokego ya tshedimošo mabapi le GAS ka dinageng tše ntši tša letseno la fase le la magareng tša ka Afrika.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በብዙ ዝቅተኛ እና መካከለኛ ገቢ ባላቸው የአፍሪካ ሃገራት ስለ GAS የመረጃ እጥረት መኖሩንም ጠቅሰዋል።

English: Adding data from these areas might therefore give scientists a more detailed picture of the problem.
Luganda: Awo nno ebizuuliddwa ebivudde mu bitundu bino kiyinza okuwa bannassaayansi ekifaananyi ekiramba obulungi ku kizibu kino.
Yoruba: Ṣíṣe àfikún dátà tí ó ní ṣe pẹ̀lú àwọn agbègbè wọ̀nyí le è fún àwọn sayẹntísitì ní àwòrán kíkún lórí ìṣòro náà.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke ukwengeza ngolwazi oluvela kulamazwe kungenza ososayensi bayiqonde kabanzi inkinga.
Hausa: Ƙara bayanai daga waɗannan wuraren na iya ba wa masana ilimin kimiyya cikakken hoto na matsalar.
Northern Sotho: Go tsenya tshedimošo go tšwa ka makaleng a ka fao go ka fa bašomi ba dinyakišišo seswantšho ka botlalo ka ga bothata bjo.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ አካባቢዎች መረጃ መጨመር ለሳይንቲስቶች ስለ ችግሩ የበለጠ ዝርዝር መግለጫ ሊሰጣቸው ይችላል።

English: In addition, there are some GAS types that aren’t part of the emm cluster system, possibly because they are new varieties.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, waliwo ebika bya GAS ebimu ebitali kitundu ku bibinja bya muyingoro gwa emm era ng’ensonga yandiba nti bikyali bika bipya.
Yoruba: Ní àfikún, irúfẹ́ àwọn GAS kan wà tí kò sí ní ara àwọn ètò àṣùpọ̀ emm, ó ṣe ẹ́ ṣe kí ó jẹ́ nítorípé wọ́n ti dí irú ẹ̀yà tuntun.
Zulu: Kunezinhlobo zegciwane ezingeyona ingxenye yalezo ezitholakalo kwiqoqo le-emm, lokhu kungabangelwa ukuthi izinhlobo ezintsha.
Hausa: Bugu da ƙari, akwai wasu nau’o’in GAS waɗanda ba su cikin tsarin gungun emm, mai yiwuwa saboda sababbin nau’o’i ne.
Northern Sotho: Godimo ga fao, go na le mehuta ye mengwe ya GAS yeo e sego karolo ya lenaneo la dihlophana tša emm, kgonagalo e le gore go na le mehuta ye meswa.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ምናልባት አዳዲስ ዝርያዎች ስለሆኑ የኤም ስብስብ ስርዓት አካል ያልሆኑ አንዳንድ የGAS ዓይነቶች አሉ።

English: Future research focused on determining where these types fit in will contribute to better vaccine development, and better outcomes for patients in Africa.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okujja mu maaso kwatunuulira oba ng’ebika bino binaayamba mu kukulaakulanya eddagala erigema erisingako obulungi n’obujjanjabi bw’abalwadde obusingako mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Awọn iṣẹ́ iwadìí ọjọ́ iwájú tí ó bá gbájúmọ́ ibi tí àwọn ẹ̀yà wọ̀nyí le è wolé sí, yóò ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún ìṣàtúnṣe abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsárà, yí ò sí tún mú kí.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo olugxile ekutholeni ukuthi lezi zinhlobo ngabe zingena ngaphansi kwaluphi uhla okanye iqoqo, lungasiza ekutheni kusungulwe uhlobo lo mgomo ozobanomthelela nakuzo ebese uba nemiphumela emihle kubantu abaguliswa yilo leli gciwane e-Afrika.
Hausa: Binciken na nan gaba ya mayar da hankali kan tantance inda ire-iren waɗannan nau’o’in za su ba da gudummawa ga ingantaccen haɓakar magani, da sakamako mai kyau ga marasa lafiya a nahiyar Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tša ka moso di lebeletše kudu go tseba gore mehuta ye e tsena kae di tla tsenya letsogo go tšweletšo ye kaone ya moento, le dipoelo tše kaone go balwetši ka Afrika.
Amharic: እነዚህ ዓይነቶች የት እንደሚገቡ በማወቅ ላይ ያተኮረ የወደፊት ጥናት ለተሻለ የክትባት ግኝት እና በአፍሪካ ለታካሚዎች የተሻለ ውጤትን ያስገኛል።

English: The study highlights important areas for future work in an African context and is the first study of GAS emm clusters for the continent.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kutulengeza ebitundu ebikulu ebikwata ku kunoonyereza okw’omu maaso mu kitundu kya Afirika era kwe kunoonyereza okusoose okukwata ku bibinja bya emm ebya GAS ku ssemazinga ono.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí pé àkíyèsí sí àwọn ibi tí ó ṣe pàtàkì fún iṣẹ́ iwadìí lórí ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà ní ọjọ́ iwájú, bẹ́ẹ̀ si ni òhun ni iṣẹ́ ìwadìí àkọ́kọ́ lórí àṣùpọ̀ emm GAS fún àgbáyé.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lugqamisa izindawo ezibalulekile zokwenza olunye ucwaningo e-Afrika futhi lungolokuqala lokubheka izinhlobo zegciwane ezingaphansi kwe-emm ezwenikazi i-Afrika.
Hausa: Binciken ya nuna mahimman wurare don aiki na gaba a cikin nahiyar Afirka kuma shi ne binciken farko na GAS gungun emm na nahiyar.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di bolela ka ga makala a bohlokwa a mošomo wa ka moso ka seemong sa Afrika ebile ke dinyakišišo tša mathomo tša dihlophana tša GAS emm ka mo khonthinenteng.
Amharic: ጥናቱ በአፍሪካ አውድ ውስጥ ለወደፊት ስራ አስፈላጊ ዘርፎችን አጉልቶ ያሳያል፤ እና ለአህጉሪቱ ስለ GAS ኤም ስብስቦች የመጀመሪያው ጥናት ነው።

English: The work was a collaboration between researchers from South Africa and the USA.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa abanoonyereza abava mu South Afirika ne USA nga bakolaganira wamu.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ náà jẹ́ èyí tí àwọn olùwádìí láti South Africa àti USA fọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ ṣe.
Zulu: Umsebenzi lo wenziwe ngokubambisana kwabacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nabasezweni laseMelika.
Hausa: Aikin na haɗin gwiwa ne tsakanin masu bincike daga Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Amurka.
Northern Sotho: Mošomo wo e be e le tirišano magareng ga banyakišiši go tšwa ka Afrika Borwa le ka USA.
Amharic: ስራው በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በአሜሪካ ተመራማሪዎች መካከል በትብብር የተሰራ ነው።
